jobs.occupation: Accounts Payable Officer
jobs.description:
Do you have some experience in accounting or finance and would like to join a Finance team in an international environment? We are looking for a Temporary Accounts Payable Officer to strengthen a Finance team based in Brussels.
 

This is a hands-on, operational and administrative role, primarily focused on processing supplier invoices and expense sheets.
 

Job Description
 

As part of the Finance team, your main responsibilities will include:
 

Supplier invoice processing: receive, verify, encode and follow up on supplier invoices and expense sheets.
 

Cost allocation: ensure the correct allocation of expenses and cost-centre coding.
 

Administrative follow-up: contact internal colleagues and external vendors to obtain missing information or resolve discrepancies.
 

Payments and reconciliations: support supplier payment processing and assist with vendor reconciliations.
 

Accounting closings: contribute to monthly and yearly closing activities and follow up on outstanding payables.
 

Reporting and procedures: contribute to accurate Accounts Payable administration and ensure compliance with internal controls and procedures.

 
 

Profile We Are Looking For
 

You ideally have initial experience in accounting, finance or financial administration.
 

You have a basic understanding of accounting and bookkeeping. Extensive accounting expertise is not required.
 

You are comfortable working with administrative and financial data and have a strong eye for detail.
 

You have a good working knowledge of Microsoft Office 365, particularly Excel and Outlook.
 

You have a good command of Dutch, French and English.
 

Experience with an IBM-based platform is an asset, but willingness to learn is equally important.
 

You are structured, reliable, accurate and comfortable handling recurring operational tasks.
 

You are communicative, curious and not afraid to ask questions or seek support when needed.

jobs.occupation: Product Specialist Fiber Lasers & Press Brakes - Europe
jobs.description:
European HQ Brussels | Fiber Laser & Press Brake Expertise | Technical & Commercial Support | International En
Join the European headquarters of an international CNC machine tool manufacturer as a Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake in Brussels. In this permanent role, you will combine technical product expertise with commercial support, helping dealers, sales teams and customers across Europe find the right fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 
You will work in an international environment and travel approximately one week per month across Europe for customer and dealer visits, machine demonstrations and trade fairs. Job at a glance
• Location: Brussels, Belgium
• Contract: Permanent
• Working hours: Full-time, 38 or 40 hours per week
• Salary: Up to approximately €5,500 gross per month, depending on experience
• Travel: Approximately one week per month within Europe
• Languages: Fluent Dutch and English
• Education: Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field
• Benefits: Electric company car, charging or fuel card, insurance, pension plan and €10 meal vouchers
• Working hours: Flexible
About the organisation

This international machine tool manufacturer is a market leader in CNC machine tools across the Western world. Its product portfolio includes CNC machining centers, lathes, fiber lasers and press brakes.
To further strengthen its fiber laser and press brake activities in Europe, the company is looking for a Product Specialist who combines technical expertise with strong commercial awareness.
 
You will join a small, approachable and international team at the European headquarters in Brussels. The working environment offers considerable autonomy and short communication lines.

 

Your new role

 
As Product Specialist Fiber Laser & Press Brake, you will be the European point of reference for fiber laser and press brake solutions.
 
You will support dealers, sales teams and end customers throughout the commercial and technical process, from pre-sales and machine configuration to demonstrations, training, product launches and technical support.
 
What will you do?
 

• Provide technical support for product- and application-related questions.
• Advise customers, dealers and sales teams on applications and suitable machine configurations.
• Analyse and resolve product-related technical challenges.
• Support dealers and sales teams throughout commercial sales processes.
• Develop clear product positioning and technical sales arguments.
• Deliver product and application training to dealers and sales teams.
• Demonstrate fiber laser and press brake machines at customer sites, events and trade fairs.
• Support new product launches across the European market.
• Gather customer, dealer and market feedback and identify potential business opportunities.
• Collaborate with Sales, Service, Marketing and Product Management.
• Maintain regular contact with international colleagues and stakeholders.The position covers the European market, with approximately one week of international travel per month.
 
 
 

What do you need?
 
Essential
• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in a technical field.
• Experience in a technical, engineering, product management or technical-commercial environment.
• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
• The ability to translate technical challenges into practical solutions.
• Strong communication skills and the ability to explain technical information clearly to different audiences.
 

• A customer-focused and commercially minded approach.
• Experience coordinating projects and working with internal and external stakeholders.
• A structured way of working with attention to quality and detail.
• A proactive and results-oriented mindset.
• Fluent Dutch and English.
• Willingness to travel approximately one week per month within Europe.Your strengths
 
You are eager to learn and motivated to develop in-depth knowledge of fiber laser, press brake and CNC machine technologies. You enjoy combining technical problem-solving with customer contact and commercial thinking, and you are comfortable working with colleagues and stakeholders across different European markets.

jobs.occupation: Inetum - Security Consultant Microsoft

Your responsibilities

• Develop and optimize detection rules, playbooks, and dashboards in Sentinel
 
• Perform threat analyses, security assessments, and support incident investigations
 
• Advise clients on best practices in Microsoft Security, focusing on proactive defense and efficient SOC operations
 
• Deliver clear technical documentation and provide training sessions for end users and administrators

Additional Information

Discover your future with inetum belgium

 
• Make a Difference with a Meaningful Career: step into a role where your work truly matters. At Inetum Belgium, you'll have the chance to impact lives and drive meaningful change every day.
 
• Grow and Evolve Professionally: embrace a culture of continuous learning and development. We offer a range of training opportunities designed to help you expand your skills and advance your career.
 
• Unlock Relevant Career Opportunities: pursue the career path you've always dreamed of with tailored opportunities and the IT expertise you need to succeed.
 
• Achieve Work-Life Balance: we value your well-being. Enjoy flexible working hours, the convenience of satellite offices, the comfort of home working, and an informal, no-nonsense environment.
 
• Enjoy Generous Annual Leave: life is more than just work. Take advantage of 32 days of annual leave to relax and recharge.
 
• Travel in Comfort: forget the hassle of commuting. We provide a company car and a national fuel/charging card...
...

• Proven knowledge and hands-on experience with Microsoft Defender XDR and Microsoft Sentinel
